text:
During the reported 2026 periods, the adverse event summary includes the 30-day all-cause readmission rate and the hospital-acquired pressure injury rate.

For READM-30, the 30-day all-cause readmission rate was reported for 2026-Q1. The measure recorded a numerator of 188, a denominator of 1325, and 43 exclusions. The reported rate was 14.66 percent. Event dates listed for this measure were 2026-01-24, 2026-04-18, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-17, and 2026-11-21.

For HAPI-02, the hospital-acquired pressure injury rate was reported for 2026-Q2. The measure recorded a numerator of 41, a denominator of 210, and 15 exclusions. The reported rate was 21.03 percent. Event dates listed for this measure were 2026-01-24, 2026-07-04, 2026-07-19, 2026-09-18, and 2026-11-09.

Across the submitted records, both measures include specified reporting periods, numerator counts, denominator counts, exclusions, calculated rates, and event date lists. READM-30 is reported in percent for 2026-Q1, and HAPI-02 is reported in percent for 2026-Q2. The available structured records do not include case-level descriptions, severity classifications, preventability determinations, unit locations, patient outcomes beyond the measure definitions, or documented corrective actions. Therefore, this narrative is limited to the reported measure names, periods, counts, exclusions, rates, units, and event dates provided in the source records.
